facts.text: General Intuition builds large action models and world models that can perceive, predict, and act across virtual and physical environments.
General Intuition builds on the strength of Medal, the world's largest and fastest-growing platform for gaming clips, where millions of gamers capture, share, and discover new games every year.
General Intuition teaches agents spatial reasoning using video game clips.
General Intuition released MIRA, a playable multiplayer world model of a Rocket League-style game, built with Kyutai, in collaboration with Epic Games.
DIAMOND's lead authors now work at General Intuition. DIAMOND is a diffusion world model of Atari games and Counter-Strike that people can play.
facts.source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.12399 and its project page https://diamond-wm.github.io (May 2024, before General Intuition) and GI's launch post of 2025-10-16, which thanks its lead authors by name

facts.text: Medal's backend powers everything from real-time in-app communications and storage of billions of user-generated clips to our ML-based feed and social features.
The Senior / Lead Backend Engineer works closely with product, infra, and data teams to architect and build highly scalable, low-latency systems.

The Product Designer joins a small, talented product team designing consumer-facing experiences built around gaming culture and creator-driven communities, and owns meaningful parts of the product end to end, from the core flows players use every day to the design system that keeps the team moving fast.
